Status: Wave 239 accepted (6.3): Knx.Ets.ObjectModel.Operations.ExtendedCopy and ExtendedCopy.Patcher - the XML copy/merge helpers

Method.evidence: Each row read from its own IL (NameCandidates --inspect-methods via perf-now/ilinspect.py). The copy operations repeat one shape - find the target node by //{0}:X[@Id='{1}'], write the Behavior/Target/NumberOfCopy attributes, remove the collected nodes - so the same names are used in each operation: FindTargetSpaceNode/FindTargetGroupRangeNode/FindTargetTradeNode, MarkAsCopyTarget, CollectNodesToRemove, RemoveNodes, GetDescription.
Method.state machines: ExtendedCopyExporter's three iterators are backed by state machines whose metadata names survived obfuscation: <GetDeviceInstanceCallbacks>d__3, <GetProjectSources>d__4 and <GetInstallationSources>d__5, so those rows carry the original names.
Method.segment and security helpers: ExtendedCopySegmentValidation's three CouplingDirection overloads are named for their inputs (mask version, medium-type list, coupler); SecureTableLimitsValidator resolves the keep-existing ranges and their Security attribute; ExtendedCopyAddressStrategy carries the literal bounds (0/1, 65534, 255, 2047 and the Project.Constants maxima).

SpotChecks: CopyBuildingPartExtendedOperation.a(IBuildingPart, XmlElement, XmlDocument, XmlNamespaceManager, ref List<XmlNode>) -> FindTargetSpaceNode: selects //{0}:Space[@Id='{1}'] of the target building part.
CreateMissingTopologyElementsPatcher: CreateSegmentNode writes '{0}_S-{1}' with Segment/MediumTypeRefId/Number, CreateLineNode writes '{0}_L-{1}' with Address/Behavior/NumberOfCopy.
